destination.title: De Sitter quantum descriptions, observables and horizon dynamics
destination.question: How can de Sitter systems be described and measured, and how do their fields, states, horizons and effective theories respond to consistency tests and perturbations?
destination.summary: A broad research neighborhood joining operational quantum questions, candidate quantum definitions, field dynamics, horizon physics and effective-theory tests. Numerical proximity establishes neither question equivalence nor a universal conclusion about stability.

systems: Pure, asymptotically, approximately and static-patch de Sitter settings
De Sitter-sliced geometries, without assuming that the full bulk is a de Sitter vacuum
Quantum fields, higher-spin gravity, strings and proposed coherent or excited states
targets: Physical observables, state spaces and quantum definitions
State-dependent stability, decay, screening and backreaction
Matter spectra, scalar extrema and effective-theory consistency
regimes: Classical geometry, fixed-background QFT and semiclassical gravity remain separate
Perturbative calculations and proposed nonperturbative definitions
Four-dimensional constructions and explicitly different bulk, slice or reduction dimensions
Matter-dominated cosmology appears as an additional regime in the accretion source

Vacuum choice, boundary conditions and observer access are retained where stated
No common Swampland premise is imposed
conventions: Preserve each source's scalar-potential normalization and dimensional conventions
Distinguish global, static-patch, event-horizon and apparent-horizon questions
includes: Surveys and setting facets, identified as such

Links to broader operational and QFT questions
excludes: A universal de Sitter instability, finite-state theorem or quantum-gravity exclusion
Automatic identification of detector thermality with geometric backreaction
Automatic equivalence of consistent truncations and low-energy effective theories

sources.title: De Sitter space and eternity

evidence.text: Can infrared quantum effects prevent de Sitter space from being an eternal background, and could the resulting instability support cosmological-constant screening and a gauge/string description?

sources.title: Higher Spin de Sitter Hilbert Space

evidence.text: Can minimal higher-spin de Sitter gravity receive a microscopic Hilbert space, operator algebra and normalizable Hartle–Hawking state that reproduce perturbative expectations while defining nonperturbative probabilities?

sources.title: On the de Sitter swampland criterion

evidence.text: Do unstable ten-dimensional de Sitter solutions violate a conjecture about four-dimensional quantum-gravity effective theories? The paper separates three possibilities: invalid backgrounds, a mismatch between consistent and low-energy truncations, and a weaker criterion concerning stable vacua.

sources.title: Four-dimensional de Sitter space is a Glauber-Sudarshan state in string theory

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime be constructed in string theory as a coherent state over a supersymmetric Minkowski background, while addressing quantum stability, trans-Planckian obstructions, vacuum energy and finite entropy?

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Glauber-Sudarshan State

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional de Sitter geometry and its fluctuations arise as expectation values of states over a supersymmetric string-theory Minkowski vacuum, with quantum corrections controlled and a consistent account of supersymmetry breaking, trans-Planckian modes and entropy?

sources.title: de Sitter Bubbles and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which initial-state prescription permits a finite nonzero observer nucleation rate while retaining a preferred state in de Sitter space?

sources.title: Instability of de Sitter space under thermal radiation in different vacua

evidence.text: Under which vacuum choices does scalar thermal radiation produce a net flux and change the four-dimensional de Sitter horizon area? Observer-dependent detection of thermality alone is explicitly insufficient to establish geometric instability.

sources.title: Clock Fields and Logarithmic Decay of Dark Energy

evidence.text: Is the infrared screening of de Sitter expansion in the reviewed conformal-mode formalism locally measurable, and how does an independent clock field change that conclusion?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua & pUniverses

evidence.text: Do the charge-p Schwinger model's spontaneously broken discrete symmetries survive on global de Sitter space, and can its vacuum structure persist after coupling to positive-cosmological-constant gravity?

sources.title: Symmetries, matrices, and de Sitter gravity

evidence.text: Which reduced spacetime symmetries could support a matrix description of de Sitter gravity, do IMF-like and DLCQ-like constructions agree, and can a Newton-Hooke matrix model account for holographic scaling and a possible transition between infinite and finite Hilbert spaces?

sources.title: De sitter space with finitely many states: A Toy story

evidence.text: Can finite-dimensional de Sitter state spaces support a unitary, de Sitter-invariant S-matrix if the Hamiltonian need not be Hermitian and symmetry generators may mix incoming and outgoing states?

sources.title: (Anti)evaporation of Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes

evidence.text: How do one-loop quantum effects affect the stability of nearly degenerate Schwarzschild–de Sitter black holes, and which perturbation is selected when cosmological black-hole pairs nucleate subject to the no-boundary condition?

sources.title: Quantum global structure of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Does the simple global structure of classical de Sitter space survive black-hole nucleation and quantum radiation, and what would fragmentation of future infinity imply for proposed holographic surfaces?

sources.title: De Sitter space and eternity

evidence.text: Analytic continuation and Legendre P/Q propagators are combined with spectral decompositions. Jost modes and Wronskian identities relate scattering reflection to mode integrals and the imaginary part of the vacuum effective action.

sources.title: Higher Spin de Sitter Hilbert Space

evidence.text: Construct physical states by finite-K group averaging, then take K→∞ with normalized states. Trace identities exchange the K×K Gram matrix for a 2N×2N matrix; fixed-degree continuum moments reduce to a real symmetric Gaussian matrix integral.

sources.title: On the de Sitter swampland criterion

evidence.text: Expand higher-dimensional fields on a finite left-invariant basis and reduce the closed sector. For a consistent truncation, solve the lower-dimensional equations and lift their solutions. In this application, the retained sector contains the known group-manifold de Sitter backgrounds.

sources.title: Four-dimensional de Sitter space is a Glauber-Sudarshan state in string theory

evidence.text: Construct |σ⟩=D(σ)|Ω⟩ from the interacting vacuum, with displacement parameters for both metric and C-field components. The proposed time-dependent D combines the non-unitary part of a harmonic-vacuum displacement with an exponential involving the full interaction Hamiltonian; its definition is chosen to reproduce the target background.

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Glauber-Sudarshan State

evidence.text: Use normalized, off-shell path integrals to compute field expectation values with displacement insertions. Normalization denominators matter for nonunitary displacement prescriptions. Wilsonian coarse graining integrates Euclidean momentum shells between a chosen scale and a UV cutoff.

sources.title: de Sitter Bubbles and the Swampland

evidence.text: Use Euclidean bounce rates Γ=P exp(−S). In the flat-space thin-wall limit, S scales as T⁴/(ΔΛ)³ and P as T⁴/(ΔΛ)²; numerical factors are generally omitted.

sources.title: What if string theory has a de Sitter excited state?

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional de Sitter arise as an excited state over a supersymmetric Minkowski vacuum, avoiding the authors' objections to vacuum constructions while satisfying quantum equations of motion and effective field theory criteria?

sources.title: de Sitter space as a BRST invariant coherent state of gravitons

evidence.text: Can de Sitter geometry be represented by a BRST-invariant graviton coherent state over Minkowski, and can that construction capture particle creation within controlled limits?

sources.title: Proliferation of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can higher Fourier perturbations of a spontaneously nucleated de Sitter handle produce multiple evaporating black holes, causing spatial fragmentation rather than semiclassical perdurance, and what would this imply for inflationary global structure?

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric Euclidean vector models define a well-behaved Hartle-Hawking wavefunction through dS/CFT, providing evidence for stable supersymmetric de Sitter space in higher-spin gravity?

sources.title: Fubini vacua as a classical de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can the symmetry, information geometry, proposed entropy, and radiation properties of Fubini scalar configurations support their interpretation as classical de Sitter vacua with cosmological constant determined by the scalar coupling?

sources.title: Schottky Anomaly of deSitter Black Holes

evidence.text: What does Schottky-type behavior in Schwarzschild–de Sitter thermodynamics reveal about possible microscopic degrees of freedom, and how far can constrained spin systems and quantum particle-production results capture its two-temperature, non-equilibrium character?

sources.title: A Critique of pure string theory: Heterodox opinions of diverse dimensions

evidence.text: How should black-hole dominance reshape background independence, vacuum selection, and the cosmological constant problem, and can finite-state de Sitter quantum mechanics explain supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: On the de Sitter swampland criterion

evidence.text: Which constant-scalar configurations of a four-dimensional gravitational potential describe de Sitter, Minkowski, or anti-de Sitter spacetime? In the paper's action convention, extrema satisfy R4 = 2V and have cosmological constant Λ = V/2.

sources.title: Unruh-DeWitt detector responses for complex scalar fields in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: What response does a comoving pointlike Unruh–DeWitt detector have when quadratically coupled to a complex scalar in de Sitter spacetime, and how do regularization, massless minimal coupling, and α-vacuum choice affect its interpretation?

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of stable de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can a finite-state quantum theory of stable de Sitter space reproduce semiclassical local physics and explain cosmological supersymmetry breaking (CSB), including its dependence on the cosmological constant?

sources.title: Distance Conjecture and De-Sitter Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: The classical Einstein–scalar system determines how a radial scalar deformation changes the de Sitter-sliced geometry and its entropy integrals. The explicit example sets the scalar potential to zero in four bulk dimensions.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How do strongly coupled quantum fields respond to perturbations, broken translations, anomalies and time-dependent driving? The thesis also asks whether entanglement supplies consistency conditions for de Sitter matter and calculable observables along T\bar T flows.

sources.title: The IR stability of de Sitter QFT: results at all orders

evidence.text: Is the interacting Hartle-Hawking state of massive scalar QFT in de Sitter space perturbatively well defined and infrared stable, with connected N-point functions decaying at large separation at every perturbative order?

sources.title: De Sitter holography with a finite number of states

evidence.text: Can de Sitter holography have finitely many observer-accessible states, a unitary S-matrix, and de Sitter symmetry despite the obstruction to nontrivial finite-dimensional unitary representations of the de Sitter group?

sources.title: On the Positivity of de Sitter Group Averaging

evidence.text: On which domains is the de Sitter group-averaging inner product positive semidefinite, so that it can implement gravitational linearization-stability constraints? Does absolute convergence alone ensure positivity?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Can nodal-diagram path integrals and generalized Borel resummation determine quantum corrections to a four-dimensional de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan state, including its cosmological constant and displacement from the interacting vacuum?

sources.title: Adventures in de Sitter space

evidence.text: What do semiclassical horizon thermodynamics, entropy bounds and Nariai instabilities imply for possible quantum descriptions of de Sitter space? This is a selective survey of results and open problems.

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: DS/dS proposes that gravity in a D-dimensional de Sitter bulk is described by two cutoff CFTs coupled to gravity on a d = D − 1 de Sitter slice.

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: Can semiclassical thermal backreaction be promoted to a quantum-gravity restriction on de Sitter lifetimes? The paper treats this promotion, and transfer of flat-space thermal scaling to curved backgrounds, as premises of its censorship argument.

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on de Sitter space

evidence.text: Review classical de Sitter geometry, free scalar quantum field theory, horizon temperature and entropy as background for de Sitter quantum gravity; explain the conformal asymptotic symmetry underlying the proposed dS/CFT correspondence and derive suitable metric falloffs.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can stable de Sitter solutions belong to a consistent quantum theory of gravity? The source motivates its entropy study through qualitative conjectures about scalar-potential slopes or negative mass squared.

sources.title: Implication of the swampland distance conjecture on the Cohen–Kaplan–Nelson bound in de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does nonvacuum matter change an initially de Sitter cosmological horizon when the same energy is compared with a Schwarzschild–de Sitter black hole?

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space receive a potentially rigorous quantum definition as a resonance in transition amplitudes between particular excited states of asymptotically supersymmetric flat vacua? The diagnostic is a pole in a spectral representation of such an amplitude.

sources.title: My Personal History With the Quantum Theory of de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Clarify the author's account of the history of finite-state de Sitter quantum theory and explain its implications for locality, the limits of QFT and the information accessible to physical detectors.

sources.title: An Effective Description of the Instability of Coherent States of Gravitons in String Theory

evidence.text: Can perturbations by other string-field coherent states drive a pure graviton coherent state toward mixed-state equilibrium under SEAQT, and how might its relaxation scale relate to de Sitter classical and quantum breaking?

sources.title: Thermal derivation of the Coleman-De Luccia tunneling prescription

evidence.text: Determine a decay rate and post-transition initial conditions from a thermal scalar theory confined to a de Sitter causal diamond. The central issue is whether the usual Euclidean prescription requires information outside the observer's horizon.

sources.title: Festina Lente: EFT Constraints from Charged Black Hole Evaporation in de Sitter

evidence.text: Must every black-hole perturbation of a long-lived de Sitter static patch eventually equilibrate back to empty de Sitter?

sources.title: Quantum instability of the de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can interacting quantum fields destabilize fixed de Sitter backgrounds through particle production, infrared divergences and noncommuting UV/IR limits, allowing symmetry breaking and large backreaction?

sources.title: Thermodynamic interpretation of the de Sitter swampland conjecture

evidence.text: How does a changing scalar potential affect the energy density and horizon entropy of an approximately de Sitter cosmological region?

sources.title: Finite number of states, de Sitter space and quantum groups at roots of unity

evidence.text: Can root-of-unity deformations furnish finite-state toy models that support cosmological supersymmetry breaking, especially a breaking scale parametrically larger than the deformation scale? The paper also explores analogies with de Sitter black holes and sign-dependent state counting.

sources.title: Accretion of generalized Chaplygin gas onto cosmologically coupled black holes

evidence.text: How does perturbative accretion of generalized Chaplygin gas, including metric backreaction, change the effective mass and black-hole/cosmological apparent horizons in matter-dominated and de Sitter cosmological regimes?

sources.title: Recurrent nightmares? Measurement theory in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Assuming asymptotic de Sitter space has finitely many quantum states, what can internal observers measure, can Poincaré recurrences be verified, and can measurements select a unique mathematical dynamics?

sources.title: Some thoughts on the quantum theory of de sitter space

evidence.text: What can semiclassical gravity and self-consistent measurement theory say about a hypothetical finite-state quantum theory of de Sitter space, its observables, mathematical ambiguities and flat-space limit? The paper summarizes two lectures and presents an exploratory toy model.

sources.title: Spiky strings in de Sitter space

evidence.text: How do de Sitter acceleration and its cosmological horizon modify semiclassical folded and spiky string Regge trajectories, their compatibility with the Higuchi bound and their ability to supply arbitrarily high spins?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: How does a small localized mass perturb the horizons of a de Sitter observer? The setting uses the two positive roots of the static Schwarzschild–de Sitter geometry.

sources.title: Supersymmetric, cold and lukewarm black holes in cosmological Einstein-Maxwell theory

evidence.text: Which cosmological Reissner–Nordstrøm solutions are cold, in thermal equilibrium with a de Sitter horizon, or supersymmetric, and how do these criteria differ when Λ is nonzero?

sources.title: Back(reaction) to the Future in the Unruh-de Sitter State

evidence.text: Can an asymmetric de Sitter analogue of the black-hole Unruh state be physically admissible, and what stress tensor and semiclassical backreaction would it produce?

sources.title: Quantum Break-Time of de Sitter

evidence.text: Can resolving a classical de Sitter background as a quantum coherent state expose cumulative corrections absent from a fixed-background semiclassical treatment, and estimate when its classical metric description fails?

sources.title: De Sitter Stability and Coarse Graining

evidence.text: Does de Sitter space remain self-consistent under semiclassical back reaction when the gravitational source is calculated after tracing over states beyond a local observer’s cosmological event horizon?

sources.title: De Sitter Musings

evidence.text: How should observables, horizon entropy and quantum gravity be formulated in asymptotically de Sitter space, distinguishing a static-patch observer from a metaobserver accessing future-boundary data?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Can de Sitter geometry coexist with a Wilsonian low-energy construction when its fluctuation frequencies and potentially its massive spectra vary with time?

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Can conversion of a primordial cosmic axion background in Coma's magnetic field reproduce both the luminosity and radial morphology of its soft X-ray excess, and what conditional restrictions follow for the axions and their production?

sources.title: ALP Conversion and the Soft X-ray Excess in the Outskirts of the Coma Cluster

evidence.text: Can conversion of a homogeneous cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and radial morphology of Coma's outskirts soft X-ray excess with parameters compatible with the earlier central-region analysis?

sources.title: A Cosmic ALP Background and the Cluster Soft X-ray Excess in A665, A2199 and A2255

evidence.text: Can a cosmic ALP background reproduce the magnitude and morphology of the soft X-ray excesses in A2199 and A2255 while remaining compatible with the absence of an observed excess in A665?

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Generate a random vector potential with Rayleigh-distributed amplitudes, uniform phases, and power proportional to k^-n; take its Fourier-space curl and transform to a Gaussian tangled magnetic field. Apply infrared/ultraviolet cutoffs and a radial density-dependent modulation.

sources.title: ALP Conversion and the Soft X-ray Excess in the Outskirts of the Coma Cluster

evidence.text: Estimate conversion semi-analytically by integrating the homogeneous-domain conversion probability per unit length over energy, emitting volume, and a coherence-length distribution inferred from the magnetic spectrum. The domain-length interval is Λmin/2 to Λmax/2.

sources.title: A Cosmic ALP Background and the Cluster Soft X-ray Excess in A665, A2199 and A2255

evidence.text: Generate a stochastic magnetic field from a random Fourier-space vector potential with power-law amplitudes and uniform phases; take its Fourier curl and transform to position space. Impose wavelength cutoffs and a radial envelope B ∝ ne^η. Electron densities follow β profiles, with a double β profile for the cool-core cluster A2199.

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Integrate conversion probabilities against the adopted CAB spectrum to obtain intrinsic annular luminosities in 0.2–0.4 keV; adjust M to normalize the total excess. Repeated Model 1 realizations varied by at most 9%, usually below 5%; comparisons include an assigned 10% simulation uncertainty.

sources.title: Soft X-ray Excess in the Coma Cluster from a Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: The simulation uses a 2000^3 lattice with 0.5 kpc cells, approximately 1 Mpc^3. A three-state axion/photon system is propagated by local rotations and exact constant-cell evolution, recursively along 2000^2 sightlines at 14 energies from 25 eV to 2 keV.

sources.title: ALP Conversion and the Soft X-ray Excess in the Outskirts of the Coma Cluster

evidence.text: Use the 4°–6° annulus for contemporaneous RASS background subtraction, normalize the thermal component with R7 counts, and extract an R2 excess using alternative CAB, warm-plasma, or power-law spectra. Xspec/APEC includes plasma emission lines.

sources.title: Excess Astrophysical Photons from a 0.1–1 keV Cosmic Axion Background

evidence.text: Can a primordial 0.1–1 keV Cosmic Axion Background (CAB), converted into photons by astrophysical magnetic fields, explain galaxy-cluster soft X-ray excesses and contribute to the unresolved cosmic X-ray background?
